reviews.text:
I genuinely regret paying for this subscription. The entire reason I purchased the app was to select my photos/videos, place them into one of the provided templates, and have the app generate the finished video. That basic function simply did not work.

I spent about an hour selecting my media THREE separate times, closing and reopening the app, and even restarting my phone trying to troubleshoot it. Every time, the exported video came out blank without the media I selected.

I eventually had to spend another 3–4 HOURS manually editing the video myself, which completely defeats the purpose of paying for an app like this in the first place.

What makes this worse is that this is one of the most expensive app subscriptions I’ve ever purchased. I contacted Apple for a refund, clearly explained that the product did not function as advertised, and was denied.

So I paid a premium price for software that failed at the exact task I purchased it to perform, wasted hours troubleshooting it, then had to do the work manually anyway.

Save your money. Based on my experience, I absolutely cannot recommend paying for this app.

reviews.title: Best outputs, worst subscription model
reviews.text:
I’ve tried a lot of content creation apps for Reels and Stories, and this one honestly gives me some of the best results so far. The AI concepts and templates are strong and I love how easy it is to build branded content.
But there is so much room for improvement. The AI often produces errors or lines of text that simply don’t make sense, so I have to redo or heavily edit a lot of what it generates. That would be fine if the pricing model matched the experience, but it really doesn’t.
I’m on the Professional subscription, paying the highest tier, and I still have to deal with a very limited credit system for AI tools. Credits expire every week and don’t roll over, so I’m constantly watching the counter instead of just creating. For a pro‑level paid plan, a hard credit cap feels ridiculous. If I’m paying monthly at the top tier, I should have unlimited or at least very generous access to the AI features, not be throttled like a free user.[apple
Right now I’m honestly unsure if I’ll keep this as my primary creation tool or go back to apps like Photoleap, Videoleap, or CapCut, which feel more transparent and less restrictive with what you can actually do once you’re paying. Until they rethink the credit system and improve AI stability, it’s hard to recommend this to serious creators.

reviews.title: Unreasonable upgrades
reviews.text:
I have been using Instories Pro for a little over a year for my small business. I LOVED IT!  I was continuous being praised for the quality of my photos and was very happy with how easy it was to use. I recommended it to other folks with similar businesses. Today, I tried editing a new batch of photos. I was no longer allowed to save them, and was asked to upgrade to Instories Max (apparently a new upgrade) to do the same thing I have been doing with Pro all along. To make things worse, my Pro subscription (which is already quite pricey) renewed a month ago. 
Extremely annoying! At this rate and with these policies, they will be losing customers very quickly. They’ve lost me!
